name: omi_record_seal_repair_rows
description: Singleton row outcomes; disposition is a closed runtime allowlist, never provider text.

name: omi_record_seal_repair_seal_age_seconds
description: Observed age in seconds, not a complete backlog census.
filter: resource.type="k8s_container" AND resource.labels.namespace_name="prod-omi-backend" AND resource.labels.container_name="repair" AND jsonPayload.event="record_seal_repair_row" AND (jsonPayload.disposition="sealed" OR jsonPayload.disposition="sealed_registered")

name: omi_record_seal_repair_oldest_unsealed_seconds
description: Observed age in seconds, not a complete backlog census.
filter: resource.type="k8s_container" AND resource.labels.namespace_name="prod-omi-backend" AND resource.labels.container_name="repair" AND jsonPayload.event="record_seal_repair" AND jsonPayload.outcome="ok"
